title: Good Suction; Nice not to deal with a cord; power head is heavy
text: Good Suction; Nice not to deal with a cord; power head is heavy. I haven't used this for very long, but I like to review things based on first impressions, as often they seem the most accurate.  First of all, this is easy to assemble; together in 5 minutes with no tools needed; just snap the sections together.  One thing that I didn't like right away is that the two included attachments don't have on-board storage.  Apparently Shark sells an overpriced accessory to hold the attachments.  For the high price of this vacuum, they should include this.  The second thing I noticed right away is the vacuum cannot stand upright without collapsing and folding down the handle (but that is easy to do).  I gave it a quick cleaning run around in several rooms in the house and it seems to have strong pickup capability and actually almost drives itself, so it moves along smoothly and rapidly.  Simple switch to go from hard floors to carpet and back again.  The biggest issue that I would have with this vacuum is that the power head (which also doubles as a hand vacuum, which is easily detachable), is quite heavy.  You have to hold most of that weight of the power head while using the machine, as the angle that it has to be held at in order to clean puts most of the weight on your arm.  If you are young and strong, maybe not a big issue, but if you were doing a whole house, your arm might hurt after using it for more than a few minutes.  If you can't lift much weight, then this is not the vacuum for you, but the total weight is not bad; it is lighter than a typical vacuum.  The collapsing handle is a nice feature for getting under furniture, so I should be able to clean some places that haven't been in a long time.  Not having to deal with a cord is a huge plus and the two rechargeable batteries that you can swap are also great.  The batteries seem strong, but I haven't run the vacuum long enough to know if they last as long as claimed.  They do take a while to charge.  The battery packs are easy to swap in and out and have indicator lights showing charge progress and how much charge is left; they are well designed.  I should give this more than a 3-star rating, but having to hold the weight of the power head/hand vac while using the machine could be a real problem if using it for an extended period of time.  The dust cup is small too, so will no doubt fill up fast, but they couldn't really make it any larger without adding more weight and bulk.  Overall it is a well designed vacuum, but I know if I let my house cleaning crew use it, they will break it fast, as they will forget that you can't stand it upright without folding down the handle; they already broke one vacuum that way.
